rationale: RNG gapped up ~15% on earnings beat but has since collapsed from a session high of $98.14 all the way down to $84.81, sitting just 2.8% above today's low with price well below both VWAP ($90.09) and the 9-EMA ($88.68) — a severe intraday reversal that signals aggressive selling into the gap. The bid-ask spread of 79 bps and the stock pinned near the low with no stabilization signal make both long (fading a strong downtrend with no floor established) and short (already extended ~13.6% off the high with potential support at the gap fill zone) unattractive risk/reward setups at this moment.
